name: Close
description: Close is a sales CRM that combines built-in calling, email, and SMS with Chloe, an AI sales agent that qualifies leads, books meetings, and updates records automatically.
best_for: Sales teams, since the platform's 2013 launch, wanting to automate outbound outreach and lead qualification while reducing manual admin work.
features: Built-in calling, email, and SMS messaging in one workspace
Chloe AI agent that qualifies inbound leads, calls prospects, answers questions and objections, and books meetings
Automatic meeting booking and call transcription/summarization
Automatic CRM field updates and intelligent follow-up generation
Integrations with Gmail, Microsoft 365, Zoom, Calendly, and Zapier

tiers.name: Solo
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($19/user/month billed monthly). Limited to 1 user, 10k leads max.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($49/user/month billed monthly). Unlimited contacts and leads, team features.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($109/user/month billed monthly). Automated workflows, power dialer.

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($149/user/month billed monthly). Predictive dialer, advanced permissions.
